Bio:
Bisa Jackson, or B.J. is a black Principal at the poor high school called Scottsdale High for the past a few years. She’s very ghetto just like the rest and treats people often poorly or sexually. Even as a Principal, she earns an average salary, but the  teachers and staff members have a lack of budget, mostly because she doesn’t really do her job that much and doesn’t make much effort to the school, even though she earns money for being a Principal. She doesn’t really care about her job, but she only wants to do it for the money and sometimes have sex with the sexy students (who are 18 or higher). Even though she’s strong, she doesn’t really protect the school, especially when they’re situations going on. Whoever disrespects her or does something bad to her, she won’t hesitate to fail them, punish them with her own terms, or even…sexually torture them. Although, expelling the students happens rarely, whether the students get in serious trouble. As long as it's not much of her problem, she won’t care at all. Most of the students and adults are blacks and Latinos, a few Natives and rarely Asians. When there’s a fight at school, she doesn’t intervene, not because she’s afraid, but instead, she just watches the students fight each other and they enjoy watching them doing violence and destroying each other for almost no reason. She even encourages it, whether if the student is a bully or a victim. Funny part is, when one student lost and was knocked out, she rewarded the winner to have a secret sex and a lot of times…it worked. Anyway, outside of school, she grew up and still lives in the hood. She rarely does any school education and is not that intelligent, but she has street smarts. Sometimes, when she doesn’t have enough income from the school payments, she’ll occasionally be a prostitute. Find any man to pay her for sex. Other times, she often sneakily steals from others and gets away with it. Not only does she steal or earn money, but also different items (even from the members or students at school). Besides that, she loves shopping to buy jewelry and other good stuff. She likes to hang out in the hood, play basketball, partying, and sometimes bully weaklings for fun. She’ll bully the victim(s) with bullies. Even with her homies or her favorite students. Since she’s black, she also does stereotypes…including whooping anyone’s ass who’s racist (that are mostly white), even though she uses a lot of slurs towards any race. Overall, Bisa Jackson is a hot chocolate Principal, but still ghetto and careless on her job. Although, she only does this for money.
Fun Fact: Bisa has no college degree to become a Principal, she just got hired and was lucky enough to take over from the old Principal who quit the job.
Fun Fact 2: When a student victim is getting beat up or bullied by the bullies, she punishes the victim for not standing up for herself or disruption. Since she works at an underfunded school, the system is poor anyway.
Fun Fact 3: She only expels students by not just pushing her limits too much, but just expel them because she just doesn’t like them. Clearly shows how bossy & bitchy she is.
